description: Get funding and carry for real-world-asset perpetuals (RWA perps: stocks, pre-IPO, ETFs, indices, commodities, FX) across 13 venues: CEXs (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget, Gate, Kraken xStocks), perp DEXs (Aster, Lighter, Extended, GRVT, ApeX, Pacifica) and Hyperliquid HIP-3 builder markets. Rates are interval-true and mechanism-true: funding_apr annualizes each venue's own settlement interval (never an assumed 8h), and a both-sides rollover is reported separately as borrow_apr_annual (a cost, never mixed into funding spreads). Marks more than 2% off the cross-venue median are flagged is_price_suspect and excluded from stats and spreads. type=history returns stored session-tagged settlements (market/after_hours/weekend/holiday) for Hyperliquid and Kraken only, since 2026-07-28; type=stats returns best carry (trailing-24h realised), top cross-venue spread (comparable funding only), weekend premium, and open interest. funding_status separates a real 0 from a venue's off-hours pause or a market that never funds.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

days.description: Days of settlement history to retrieve (type=history only).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

symbol.description: Underlying ticker (e.g. TSLA, XAU, US500), case-insensitive. Required when type=history. GOOG and GOOGL are distinct share classes.

type.description: Type of rwa-perp data to retrieve.

venue.description: Filter to a single venue, case-insensitive (e.g. Binance, Bybit, OKX, Kraken, Aster, Lighter, Pacifica, or the Hyperliquid HIP-3 builder venue: Hyperliquid). The venue list is registry-driven and grows over time; an unknown venue is a 400 that names the valid ones.

name: get_rwa_perp_funding

RwaCarryMetric.description: Highest trailing-24h realised funding APR on a market with at least $1M open interest. Settlement history is stored for Hyperliquid and Kraken only, so best carry ranks those venues; null when none has at least 90% of the window covered by its settlements.

fundingApr.description: Realised funding over the trailing windowHours: the settled rates summed and annualised (x 8760 / windowHours). Never one annualised print.

settlements.description: Settlements stored in the window. The market qualifies when they cover at least 90% of the window's hours (the hours each settlement stands for), not by their count.

windowHours.description: Length of the realised window, in hours (24).

funding_rate.description: Funding as a decimal fraction per `interval_hours`: for the standard-funding venues the in-progress rate for the settlement at `next_funding_time` (Kraken's prediction, Lighter's 8h-basis rate divided by 8 for its hourly charge), so `funding_rate × notional` estimates the next payment. GET /api/funding/rates serves Kraken's last settled rate for the same market instead (see its `rate_kind`). `null` when the venue published none.

funding_status.description: What funding_rate means now. live: non-zero. zero: exactly 0 while the underlying's home market is open, on a market that has printed non-zero funding (a real 0, often a formula's dead band). paused: exactly 0 while the home market is closed on a market that does fund (Bitget and Bybit stock perps settle 0 outside US hours). zero_by_design: exactly 0 on a market that has never printed non-zero funding. none: no periodic funding (rollover venues). Only live and zero enter stats spreads.

interval_hours.description: Hours between this market's settlements: the span `funding_rate` is charged over, and the gap to `next_funding_time`.

price_deviation.description: The mark's deviation from the cross-venue median mark, a fraction (0.01 is 1%). Beyond ±0.02 the row is `is_price_suspect`.

laggingVenues.description: Venue syncs behind the freshness threshold, oldest first; the rest are current. Empty when every venue is current.

spreadApr.description: maxApr - minApr: the widest trusted cross-venue funding spread, this period annualised. Legs are funding_status live or zero only: a paused or by-design 0 is never a leg.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: RWA perp funding rates
